extracted.name: Instant Pot® Mississippi Roast
extracted.description: A Mississippi pot roast recipe made for your Instant Pot® gets its flavors from pepperoncini, ranch dressing mix, and onion soup mix.
ingredient_lines: 3.5 pounds beef chuck roast, cut into 3 or 4 chunks
0.5 (16 ounce) jar pepperoncini peppers and juice
1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Pour broth into a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot®). Place beef in the pot and sprinkle with ranch dressing mix and onion soup mix. Place butter on top. Add pepperoncinis and juice.
Close and lock the pressure cooker lid. Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 110 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, 10 to 40 minutes.
